evaluation.dependence_continuum: scale the full low-rank cross-covariance by alpha and transfer removed row variance to the diagonal
evaluation.rank_energy_path: retain the minimum source-fitted factor rank reaching each fixed trace-energy fraction and transfer discarded row variance to the diagonal
evaluation.fixed_coverage_rule: within each object-query pair, accept the fixed number of lowest predicted event risks with stable index tie-breaking
evaluation.matched_reference_coverage_rule: for every arm, accept exactly the number of target windows accepted by the full arm at cost 0.1; only predicted risks, never outcomes, determine ordering
evaluation.cost_robustness_rule: full dependence must beat each control with an object-bootstrap upper bound below zero at at least four of five registered costs

claim_boundary: Retrospective robustness evidence on the already-open 92-object Deform360 cohort. A positive result supports dependence-sensitive query probabilities and outcome-blind risk ranking under fixed means and coordinate marginals. It does not establish fresh confirmation, calibrated uncertainty, Prob4D runtime competence, unseen-object transfer, robot-control safety, or general state of the art.
